guitar.notes: Jeff Beck is one of the most famous Stratocaster players, with his own long-running Fender Jeff Beck Signature Strat; extensively documented.

tone.target: aggressive wah lead with hot British crunch
tone.profile: aggressive wah lead with hot British crunch
tone.summary: A hot British crunch tone built around a Plexi/Marshall style amp, utilizing the Wah pedal for lead textures, complemented by slap delay and room reverb.

rig.name: Jeff Beck - Big Block Live - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a warm, mid-focused boost for the 'hot crunch' character.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate the initial grit of a Plexi/Marshall preamp stage before the main amp model.

blocks.purpose: The primary lead texture and aggressive wah sweeps.
Add aggressive, focused crunch and sustain without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: While the target is 'hot crunch,' RAT-style provides a tight, mid-focused aggression suitable for Jeff Beck's style.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Plexi/Marshall-style British crunch and mid-push.
Provide the classic British 4x12 cabinet sound.
Enhance the 'tight mid push' required for lead work.
Provide the required 'live arena delay' and rhythmic echo.
Add the required 'short room' ambience without muddying the tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall dimensionality to better capture the live arena feel.

proposals.reason: Enhance cabinet depth and realism for a more authentic live sound.
